trust_decision.summary: The HTTP parser decides how many body bytes belong to a message from the Content-Length value. raw_to_int narrows strtol's long to int, so values above INT_MAX wrap and the parser frames the body differently from an RFC-compliant peer.

landing_point.why: The summary names Content-Length parsing; grepping HDR_CONTENT_LENGTH leads directly to the raw_to_int call and its (unsigned int) cast in parser_get_entity_read_method

fix_sites.entry_point: raw_to_int (internal, declared in upnp/src/inc/httpparser.h:452). Reached from http_RecvMessage for server requests (upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpreadwrite.c:396), from client responses via parser_get_entity_read_method (upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpreadwrite.c:1467, upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpreadwrite.c:2274), and from SSDP M-SEARCH MX (upnp/src/ssdp/ssdp_device.c:105)
fix_sites.module_kind: core HTTP parser helper (shared integer conversion)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix changes only raw_to_int. Its SSDP caller (upnp/src/ssdp/ssdp_device.c:105) is a beneficiary that the fix did not touch.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The chunk-size route (match_int via %x) is 'chunked framing, not Content-Length', and a separate earlier advisory (GHSA-gcj7, commit 9ff9bc5) already 'handled chunked bodies', so a solver can argue it was covered elsewhere.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate Content-Length values (0, and anything up to g_maxContentLength) must still frame correctly. SSDP MX shares raw_to_int. match_int also parses the HTTP version and status code, so an over-broad change to match_int (or a tight numeric cap) would break request/status-line parsing or valid MX values.

O6_input_shapes: decimal Content-Length in (INT_MAX, UINT_MAX]: previously wrapped to a negative int, then to a large unsigned value (fix.diff:42-43)
decimal Content-Length >= 2^32: previously wrapped to a small value, e.g. 2^32+5 -> 5 (fix.diff:42-43; gtest/test_httpreadwrite.cpp:244-247)
Content-Length beyond LLONG_MAX: overflow is detected through ERANGE (fix.diff:47)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Chunk-size parsing: match_int narrows strtol's long to int (and writes it through an int* into the size_t chunk_size), so oversized hex chunk sizes wrap to small values and the chunked body is framed differently
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is chunked encoding, not Content-Length; an earlier chunked-limit advisory touched this path; and the fix lives in the generic %d/%x scanner, not the header code
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 1350 lines away from the fix site, reached through vfmatch at upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpparser.c:996-1001 and parser_parse_chunky_entity at upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpparser.c:1761

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Caller ignores raw_to_int's -1 error: an invalid or oversized Content-Length becomes (unsigned int)-1 = UINT_MAX instead of a 400. It is rejected only when g_maxContentLength > 0
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The g_maxContentLength check at upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpreadwrite.c:407-418 already rejects it with 413 in default configurations

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Make RecvWriteSize (an atoi of Content-Length, currently a dead store) drive the body length in http_RecvPostMessage
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The field already exists (upnp/src/inc/webserver.h:56) and is parsed with a different integer routine, so a second Content-Length parser in the web-server module is plausible

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The client API returns contentLength as (int)content_length; the same narrowing in the response path of UpnpOpenHttpGet (also at upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpreadwrite.c:2295)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: These are existing public-API casts. A maintainer exposing an int length to callers would naturally write this

O9_family: HTTP request smuggling / parser differential via integer truncation of the message length (CWE-190, CWE-444)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake or autotools with a C compiler; googletest under gtest/
O10_build.project_tests: gtest/test_httpreadwrite.cpp (it already includes GhsaG6c2TestSuite at gtest/test_httpreadwrite.cpp:211-295, driving http_RecvMessage over a socketpair); upnp/test/test_parser_1.py and upnp/test/test_parser_2.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Widen raw_to_int to long long with an INT_MAX check (exactly the published fix), leaving the same narrowing in match_int for chunk sizes

out_of_scope_notes: Duplicate Content-Length headers are merged with ', ' (upnp/src/genlib/net/http/httpparser.c:1579-1586), which makes raw_to_int fail. That behaviour belongs to a different mechanism and was not pursued.
ssdp_server.c uses atoi on device/service version suffixes (upnp/src/ssdp/ssdp_server.c:333-334). This is unrelated to framing.
unverified: The pinned tree already contains this advisory's regression test (gtest/test_httpreadwrite.cpp:211-295, added in the pinned commit 4620dc3). The fix diff does not add or change it (its only test change is ixml/test/poc_ghsa_q54q.c, fix.diff:5-17), so the formal regression_tests_in_pinned_commit flag does not hold. It still reveals the expected Content-Length behaviour to a solver and should be removed from our copy.
